violation_type.title: Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Obtain From Parents Child's Name and Birthdate (26 TAC §742.307(2)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Obtain From Parents Child's Name and Birthdate
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregiver did not have the required admission information for children in her care.

finding_variants.text: Caregiver did not have the required admission information for children in her care.

Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, The primary caregiver did not have records which showed she obtained the admission information from parents before admitting the children in care.
